title: The saved-identity v7 document persists fixed-count voice-template declarations

needles: voice bank round-trips through the v7 document with an audio render across voices
planted voice declaration refusals leave the graph untouched

installed_sdk.rationale: instantiate_subgraph_voices, subgraph_voice_identity, kMaxSubgraphVoices, the voice-bank to_saved_subgraph_document overload and SubgraphDocumentLoad::voice_banks are public host APIs; inspect_document refuses malformed, duplicate and dangling voice declarations.

needles: voice banks diff and undo by authored identity

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI command or option is added; pulp graph diff reports the voice_declarations section through its existing sections output.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler is added.

live_product_control.rationale: Only the authored declaration and declared parameter values are persisted and rebound on the control thread at load; no voice allocation, runtime voice state or audio-thread path is added.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest entry is added.
